name: codehaven
description: Ask CodeHaven about the open project from VS Code, and jump from a cited path:line to the code. Everything stays on your computer.

commands.title: CodeHaven: Explain the Selection in the Chat Panel
CodeHaven: Open the Chat Page for This Project
CodeHaven: Trace the Function Under the Cursor
CodeHaven: Go to a Cited Line (path:line)

codehaven.command.description: The CodeHaven command. Give the full path if it is installed in a virtual environment, such as /path/to/.venv/bin/codehaven.

codehaven.startOllama.description: Add --start-ollama, so CodeHaven starts a local Ollama server (loopback only, cloud features off) when none is running.

codehaven.extraArguments.description: More arguments for every CodeHaven run, such as ["--model", "qwen2.5:14b"].
